steps.name: New relationship (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Harmonia] in “Belos of Memories”, go to [Tiya] in “Amalun Desert”.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you Adventurer for listening to my request. Actually, there is someone else who needs help, not me.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I heard that you recently visited the Amalun Desert.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have work to do... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thanks to Adventurer, the purified wind spirits stayed in the desert for a while, and it seems they were next to a princess from another world.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: He must have been deeply troubled. When the wind spirits returned, I felt a lot of worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tiya went through something big. My younger brother… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You don’t have to tell me everything. Because it was something that could not be helped.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It would be nice if I could be of help, but I can't be of any help to him... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Instead, if you have time, Adventurer, I would like you to listen to the princess's story. As the spirit king of ‘harmony’ and ‘stability’, I ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. I promised to help Tiya if anything happens. See you later, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer.

steps.name: New relationship (2)
steps.objective: Obtain the <Pyramid Relic> from the "Hall of Rest" and bring it to [Case] at "Treasure Beach".

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer. I see you again. nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your complexion doesn’t look good. Did something happen?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: It's nothing special, it reminds me of my hometown. I'm trying to find a way to go back, but it's too vague.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I need to help Iris and find a way quickly... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: It's okay. Don't push yourself too hard. Because there must be a way. Thank you for your consideration.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Besides Adventurer, there is someone else who offered to help. Do you know someone named Case?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Case? Case in point: the archaeologist at Treasure Beach.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, you said you were an archaeologist. Let's say he was a person who studied many things, including archeology, on the Continent of Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you get here?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I don't know the details, but I heard that he came to Luman some time ago to conduct research on Eastland.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: After wandering around, he came here, met me, and talked about various things. After hearing my situation, he said he would help me.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: We had to start researching and researching artifacts from our world, but it was beyond the capabilities of Case and I.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have to go inside.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tiya, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm fine. sorry… . I'll keep telling you.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: There is a space in the Hall of Rest that contains relics that can be used as materials. I think the relics from there would be helpful to Case's research.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I know if it's there. Don't worry too much. But where is the case?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I left, saying I had to get there urgently because there were a lot of grave robbers at Treasure Beach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then there is nothing we can do. I will get the item and bring it to you right away. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, and… . no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn’t there something more you want to say?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I was going to say something, but I forgot. I'll tell you again when I remember.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look tired. Leave that job to me and get some rest. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer. Oh, you're already gone. You always try to get things done quickly... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (As Tiya is leaving Adventurer and is about to return, a woman wearing glasses is standing in front of her.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Who are you? How long have you been here?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm sorry if I surprised you. My name is Yuran, a disciple of Jiscard, the leader of the Union of Light.

steps.name: New relationship (3)
steps.objective: Obtain the <Pyramid Relic> from the "Hall of Rest" and bring it to [Case] at "Treasure Beach".

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer. long time no see. I was really thankful last time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? The reason I came here... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Huh, that thing is a pyramid relic! As expected, it is Adventurer. I know there were only a few people who went in there... . You're amazing!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give you this item. Please let me know as soon as the research is finished.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: But what should I do? There's a problem.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I think it will take a long time for me to research the history of Eastland, the Amalun Desert, and the other world of 'Ra'. furthermore… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The explanation is somewhat long, so it seems like there isn't enough data.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Bingo! As expected, you figured it out right away. I thought one would be enough, but there isn't much information about this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I'd like to ask you one more time. sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So how many do you need?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Please bring me four, no more, no less. I'm really sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back. If you find out anything so far, please let me know.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Don't worry. It's a case of keeping promises. Hehehe.

steps.name: New relationship (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ocellino] of "Twinkieb", obtain <Magic Sea Droplets>, and bring them to [Tiya] in "Amalun Desert".

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: You did a good job carrying that heavy object. It wouldn't be an average distance from there to here. You are amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was quite heavy. This should be enough, right?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Of course. It's a bit difficult, but I'll put all my knowledge and experience into it. The Union of Light already said they would provide support.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the Union of Light? Who?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I am a disciple of Jiscard, the leader of the Union of Light. What was your name? That person who wears glasses and shows decisive hand gestures and facial expressions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's Yuran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's already the one who told me to solve all the problems in the Amalun Desert... . I'm surprised that help is so easy.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Still, he was a very kind person. Anyway, I plan to report to the Union of Light as soon as my research and investigation is completed.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: By the way, I feel sorry for the princess because I think this research will broaden my career. I thought I was just satisfying my own greed... .

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Adventurer, could you please do me a favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: I want to give a gift to the princess... . I guess that gift is far away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is a gift?

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: They say the princess is from the desert and has never seen the sea. So I thought it would be good to bring something that preserves the sea.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: It would probably make a good gift, right? If it responds to the princess's magic, it will shine and become more beautiful.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Still, the beauty of the princess will shine brighter than the object that holds the sea.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Ah, Princess Tiya. Isn’t it so pretty?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are a beauty. Anyway, I guess I should take a look at Twinkieve. Then, I will get the items and go straight to Tiya.

lines.speaker: 케이스
lines.text: Yes, yes. Be careful where you go. This beach is still dangerous.

steps.name: New relationship (5)
steps.objective: Talk to [Yu-ran] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, the job was easier than I thought.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: By the way, what are you holding?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this one. Case told me to bring it to Tiya as a gift.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is an item filled with the energy of the sea, and it is said that it will react with Tiya's magical power and give a feeling of the sea.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Wow… . It's so pretty. Please let me know good people and receive these rare items.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tiya, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Ah, I suddenly thought of my father who passed away. My father also never saw the sea. And my younger brother... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, Case asked me to go see the sea with him.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm so excited. The sea... . Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank Case more than me. Because I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I am a very blessed person. I met a lot of good people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. That's because Tiya is a good person.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer. I will try my best.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: As I said last time, I will fulfill my responsibilities as a member of the royal family of Ra to the end.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, during this time, a person named Yuran came and went from Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Are you Yuran?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: He came to understand the situation here firsthand and make a plan for next time. It went away quickly, but... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: You already mentioned Adventurer. I told Adventurer that I had something to give to him and asked him to visit Luman as soon as we met.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. What is it... ?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Go right away. I don't know if it's a good thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? Then I'll go. Tea.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Come visit us anytime. I'll wait!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that you went to see Tiya in the Amalun Desert. And he told me to come to Luman… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's nothing special, I just called because I have something to give you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: By resolving the issue in the Amalun Desert, you have greatly helped us deal with the dark kingdom of Deimos.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It is difficult to go into detail, but in accordance with Master's wishes, I would like to give you a title that will be helpful in whatever you do in the future.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Ah, I will arrange a meeting with Master soon. This is probably an important story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… . all right.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then, I will tell Master that I have accepted it. Iris I will also forward this to you separately, so I hope you don’t worry too much.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And this is the billing amount.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is the fee? ah… .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's beef jerky. You would know without me telling you, right?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's good that it's Lu Man's specialty, but it's a bit frustrating that there's only one person who consumes it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hahaha, I'll figure it out somehow, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm not worried. Anyway, I will contact you later. Thank you for your continued support.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Well then, good luck. Haha, my money… . Why did you eat so much beef jerky? .
